main_text.head: II. DE ELOGIO, Deus cœli.
main_text.p: 1. Deus in Scripturis sanctis & uniuersarum creaturarum, & hominum Deus recte dicitur. Psal.24.1. Iehouæ est terra, & quicquid continet: orbis terrarum, & qui habitant in eo. Quia ipse super maria fundauit eam, &c. Ion.1.9. Deus cœli, [?] parte omnium pulcerrima pro toto sumta, uocatur.
2. Cum dicitur uniuersorū, Deus auctoritas Creatoris in creaturas designatur. Psal.47.2. Quoniam Iehouah excelsus, terribilis: Rex magnus super omne terrā.

page.notes: Greek words are uncertain: the first Greek word after "creatura" is illegible on the scan. The word after "forma serui" (marked [?]) is a Greek term I could not read with confidence. The Greek after "Deus cœli," (marked [?]) is probably συνεκδοχικῶς but is not clear enough to confirm. The reference line at the top of the page is set in the text block and is transcribed in place. The page ends mid-paragraph with "3. Hanc", which continues on the next page.
